subject: general
question: According to the Press Information Bureau, by what percentage did India's Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs) exports grow in the fiscal year 2024-25 compared to the previous year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.4285**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India's Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs) recorded a growth of **42.85% in exports** during the fiscal year 2024-25 compared to the previous year.
 
• This growth reflects India's focused efforts on boosting defense exports under the **Make in India initiative**.
 
• The **Press Information Bureau (PIB)** highlighted that defense exports have been supported by policy reforms and government initiatives.
 
• India's defense exports include military hardware such as radars, naval vessels, and ammunition, among others.
 
• The growth is part of India’s strategy to become a major global supplier of defense equipment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Defense Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs):**

 
 
• DPSUs are government-owned companies that manufacture defense equipment.
 
• Examples include Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL), and Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited.
 
 
 
• **Make in India Initiative:**
 
 
• Launched in September 2014 by the Government of India.
 
• Aims to encourage companies to manufacture in India and boost domestic manufacturing.
 
 
 
• **Defense Export Policy:**
 
 
• India has implemented policies to simplify export procedures for defense products.
 
• The government provides financial support and marketing assistance to companies exporting defense products.
 
 
 
• **Global Defense Market:**
 
 
• India is actively targeting countries in Africa, Southeast Asia, and Latin America for defense exports.
 
• India’s growing defense exports contribute to its strategic goals and economic growth.
